Quick question. Do you know how a toilet works? Of course you do. You use one several times a day. So on a scale of one to seven, how well do you understand how it works? Give yourself a number. I'm guessing you went with a five or a six. It's a toilet. It's not exactly a mystery. Okay. Now explain it. Step by step, out loud. You push the handle. Then what? Where does the water come from? Why does it all rush out at once instead of trickling? And how does the tank know when to stop filling up again? If you're anything like a lot of people, something strange just happened. A second ago you understood toilets. Now you're standing in front of an imaginary one, and the confidence has quietly left the room.
